findings.title: App session cookie missing hardening flags
findings.recommendation: Set HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax on all auth/session cookies.

findings.title: JWT stored in Web Storage (localStorage/sessionStorage)
findings.evidence: JWT (three-segment base64url) matched in Web Storage after successful login. Any XSS → full session theft. See reports/2026-08-22-stage-onebid-tyonanda/evidence-deep/01-login/storage.json
findings.recommendation: Deliver auth via HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax cookies. Do not persist bearer tokens in Web Storage.

findings.title: Legacy TLS version accepted
findings.recommendation: Disable TLS < 1.2 at the edge (Caddy: `tls { protocols tls1.2 tls1.3 }`).

findings.title: No clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options absent; CSP lacks frame-ancestors)
findings.evidence: GET https://stage-onebid.us.bci-tnlm.com/ headers: no X-Frame-Options and CSP without frame-ancestors. See reports/2026-08-22-stage-onebid-tyonanda/evidence-deep/02-dashboard/root-headers.json
findings.recommendation: Add `frame-ancestors 'none'` to CSP (or X-Frame-Options: DENY) on all authenticated app responses.

findings.title: Missing clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options)
findings.recommendation: Prefer CSP frame-ancestors 'none'; or X-Frame-Options: DENY.

findings.title: HTTPS enforced from plain HTTP
findings.recommendation: Maintain. Combine with HSTS to close first-visit downgrade window.
